This sorghum plot is small, only a small piece of my land. I keep my fertilizer coupon for the maize plot because that is what feeds my family, so I cannot waste fertilizer on sorghum. I will put a little manure from the goats if I have some left, and I plant the seed I saved from last year — sorghum from the market or extension is hard to find here. Sorghum does not need much spraying, and we have rain in Mulanje so I do not irrigate. The plot is small and intercropped, so my children and I can manage the weeding ourselves without hiring anyone.
